name: Courtship: A Dance with Love
source:
Courtship: A Dance with Love is a choice-driven adult visual novel set in the Regency Era. You play as a young Marquess who has the difficult task of finding a bride and sire an heir. You will have to make a choice between a lot of different ladies all with their own dreams and aspirations. Will you go for money, beauty, social status... or love?

[From Patreon]
translation:
《Courtship: A Dance with Love》是一部以摄政时代为背景、由选择推动的成人视觉小说。你将扮演一位年轻侯爵，肩负寻找新娘、诞下继承人的艰巨任务。你必须在众多各有梦想与抱负的女士之间作出选择。你会追求财富、美貌、社会地位…还是爱情？

[摘自Patreon]
